NDT Level III consulting in Dallas–Fort Worth: aerospace, rail, pipeline and EPC programs, and the local options

Dallas–Fort Worth is a headquarters market as much as an industrial one. Aircraft are built in Fort Worth, railcar and pipeline companies are headquartered in Dallas, and engineering and construction firms here write the NDT requirements that contractors elsewhere have to meet. That produces two kinds of request for NDT consulting services: suppliers who need a program that passes a demanding customer, and buyers who need someone to audit their suppliers. Atlantis handles both as ASNT NDT Level III consulting from Houston, with visits to North Texas for examinations and audits.

What do DFW companies ask an NDT Level 3 consultant for?

  • Aerospace suppliers to Lockheed Martin's Fort Worth plant, which builds the F-35, and to Bell in Fort Worth: an NDT program set up from scratch, on an ASNT SNT-TC-1A base, with the written practice matched clause by clause to the prime contractor's flow-down requirements and to Nadcap AC7114.
  • Railcar manufacturing and repair, an industry with deep roots in the metro (Trinity Industries is headquartered in Dallas): weld inspection procedures and records that line up with AAR quality-assurance requirements.
  • Pipeline operators and contractors, with large operators such as Energy Transfer headquartered in Dallas: procedures and personnel records that satisfy the operator's specification on PHMSA-regulated construction.
  • EPC contractors such as Jacobs in Dallas and Fluor in Irving, whose supplier quality groups need outside audits of NDT subcontractors and shop vendors.
  • Companies building an NDT program for shipyard compliance, wherever the yard is: the written practice must answer NAVSEA or class requirements as well as SNT-TC-1A; see NAVSEA NDT requirements for shipyards.

Texas rules and customer requirements in North Texas

Pressure-vessel repairs in North Texas answer to TDLR's Boiler Program, as they do statewide. Industrial radiographers on a DFW job site must hold Department of State Health Services certification, and they work for the owner's licensed radiography contractor, never for Atlantis. Aerospace suppliers answer mainly to their customers: the prime's purchase order lists the NDT specifications, and Nadcap AC7114 audits test whether the written practice and procedures actually meet them. Pipeline work adds PHMSA's construction and qualification rules through the operator.

How an aerospace NDT program is usually set up

  1. Collect every specification on the customer's purchase orders and build a compliance matrix.
  2. Write the written practice and the method procedures against that matrix.
  3. Prepare general, specific and practical examinations, run them, and complete vision records for each technician.
  4. Set up records control for certificates, calibration and procedure revisions.
  5. Hold a mock audit against the customer's checklist and Nadcap AC7114 before the real one.

How DFW's NDT consulting options compare

  • NDT Consulting Group, based in Dallas, describes Level I to III training and qualification, NDT quality-system consulting, procedure and technique-sheet development, and program auditing.
  • Industrial Inspection & Analysis runs a test lab in Irving and lists ASNT Level III certification and program and procedure development among its Texas services.
  • National inspection and testing firms such as Mistras, Acuren and ATS, whose Level III services include appointment as a client's Level III, procedure development and audits.
  • In-house Level IIIs at the primes and large suppliers.
  • Remote outsourced Level IIIs for companies that want independent sign-off without a local retainer.

How to vet an NDT Level III consultant in Dallas–Fort Worth

  • Ask for a specification compliance matrix from a past aerospace job: every PO requirement mapped to a written practice or procedure clause.
  • Compare the ASNT certificate's method list with your processes and your customer's approval list.
  • For supplier audits, ask for a sample audit report and how its findings were closed out.
  • Ask whether the consultant also trains your technicians, and if so, how the training records connect to the written practice.
  • Find out whether the consultant's firm competes with you for the same customer's work.

How Atlantis supports DFW companies

Documents are written and signed by Anoop Rayavarapu, whose ASNT NDT Level III certificate covers UT, RT, MT, PT and VT, and Atlantis can hold the outside agency Level III appointment for those methods. Drafting is remote; practical examinations, procedure demonstrations and supplier audits are carried out at the relevant facility. See aerospace NDT consulting in Fort Worth, subcontractor approval audits and outsourced ASNT NDT Level III consulting. Certification records can be kept in Atlantis ERP certificate tracking, and technicians can train through NDT training in Dallas.
